subject: Brigitte Macron appearing to push Emmanuel Macron's face as their plane door opened in Hanoi
called_fake_by: The Élysée Palace (the president's office), at first
claim: As the AP footage spread, French media reported that Macron's office first dismissed it as AI-generated and pushed by hostile accounts.
finding: The footage was real; it was shot by the Associated Press. The Élysée reversed itself and confirmed it. Macron said all the videos were real and called it a moment of joking with his wife.
outcome: The office reversed itself within about a day. A Macron ally told France Info the office had botched it by first talking about fakes.

sources.title: A video of the French president's wife shoving him went viral. Here's why it matters
Emmanuel Macron's wife Brigitte Macron appears to shove his face upon arrival in Hanoi
